content.text:
I've changed the Filter button in the Tasks tab so it stands out when filters are on instead of going dim. The build is clean and the existing filter tests pass, but I haven't looked at it in the running app, so the dim look being gone isn't checked on screen.

- **Filters on:** "Filter · N" and its funnel icon are now the full accent colour, on a faint accent tint behind the button, like a selected ghost button.
- **Filters off:** it reads "Filter" in normal text colour.
- **Hover:** the usual ghost-button hover still shows in both cases.

The likely cause was the muted colour of the Previous heading the button sits in. The button only set the accent colour on the button itself, which probably left its icon in that muted grey, so the whole button looked faded. The button and its icon now always get an explicit colour, so they no longer take on the heading's grey.

The change is in `render_filter_button` in `src/prompt_mode.rs`, and it follows the spec, which matches your prompt.
